facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; no exchange controls since 1995, and you can invoice in any currency.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: foreign currency can go into a foreign-currency bank account.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Paystack accepts individuals with a national ID; KES 600,000 limit until you register.
facts.L1_registration: Register a business name with BRS (KES 950) only if not using your own name.
facts.L2_tax_id: KRA PIN, registered online on iTax.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Work done from Kenya is taxable; Turnover Tax is 1.5% for KES 1m–25m sales.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 16% VAT; exported services are zero-rated; register above KES 5 million a year.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2019; register with ODPC above KES 5m turnover or 10 staff.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Consumer Protection Act 2012 and the Competition Authority protect online buyers.
facts.L7_incentives: Turnover Tax: a flat 1.5% final tax with simple records.
facts.D1_id_document: Kenyan National ID card (new version: the Maisha card).

watch_out.text: KRA pages disagree on the Turnover Tax ceiling (KES 25m or 50m); confirm with KRA.
PayPal to M-PESA works in USD only and costs 3% on the exchange rate.
